args.sql:
WITH sse AS (
  SELECT 
    asdkey, 
    (
      SUM(
        CASE 
          WHEN socsup = 'Strong' THEN 3 
          WHEN socsup = 'Moderate' THEN 2 
          ELSE 1 
        END + CASE 
              WHEN relqual = 'Good' THEN 3 
              WHEN relqual = 'Fair' THEN 2 
              WHEN relqual = 'Poor' THEN 1 
              ELSE 0 
            END
      ) / COUNT(*)
    ) AS sse 
  FROM 
    assessmentsocialanddiagnosis 
  GROUP BY 
    asdkey
), 
latest_sse AS (
  SELECT 
    a.abkey, 
    s.sse 
  FROM 
    assessmentbasics a 
  LEFT JOIN sse s ON a.abkey = s.asdkey 
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
      asdkey, 
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( 
        PARTITION BY asdkey 
        ORDER BY 
          abkey DESC
      ) AS row_num 
    FROM 
      assessmentsocialanddiagnosis
  ) ranked ON s.asdkey = ranked.asdkey 
  WHERE 
    row_num = 1
), 
avg_missed_appointments AS (
  SELECT 
    patref, 
    AVG(missappt) AS avg_missed_appointments 
  FROM 
    encounters 
  GROUP BY 
    patref
) 
SELECT 
  p.patkey, 
  a.avg_missed_appointments, 
  l.sse 
FROM 
  patients p 
  LEFT JOIN avg_missed_appointments a ON p.patkey = a.patref 
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
      patownerref, 
      sse, 
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( 
        PARTITION BY patownerref 
        ORDER BY 
          abkey DESC
      ) AS row_num 
    FROM 
      latest_sse
  ) l ON p.patkey = l.patownerref 
WHERE 
  row_num = 1;

  ) l ON p.patkey = l.patownerref 
WHERE 
  row_num = 1;

WITH sse AS (
  SELECT 
    asdkey, 
    (
      SUM(
        CASE 
          WHEN socsup = 'Strong' THEN 3 
          WHEN socsup = 'Moderate' THEN 2 
          ELSE 1 
        END + CASE 
              WHEN relqual = 'Good' THEN 3 
              WHEN relqual = 'Fair' THEN 2 
              WHEN relqual = 'Poor' THEN 1 
              ELSE 0 
            END
      ) / COUNT(*)
    ) AS sse 
  FROM 
    assessmentsocialanddiagnosis 
  GROUP BY 
    asdkey
), 
latest_sse AS (
  SELECT 
    a.abkey, 
    s.sse 
  FROM 
    assessmentbasics a 
  LEFT JOIN sse s ON a.abkey = s.asdkey 
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
      asdkey, 
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( 
        PARTITION BY asdkey 
        ORDER BY 
          a.abkey DESC
      ) AS row_num 
    FROM 
      assessmentsocialanddiagnosis
  ) ranked ON s.asdkey = ranked.asdkey 
  WHERE 
    row_num = 1
), 
avg_missed_appointments AS (
  SELECT 
    patref, 
    AVG(missappt) AS avg_missed_appointments 
  FROM 
    encounters 
  GROUP BY 
    patref
) 
SELECT 
  p.patkey, 
  a.avg_missed_appointments, 
  l.sse 
FROM 
  patients p 
  LEFT JOIN avg_missed_appointments a ON p.patkey = a.patref 
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
      patownerref, 
      sse, 
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( 
        PARTITION BY patownerref 
        ORDER BY 
          abkey DESC
      ) AS row_num 
    FROM 
      latest_sse
  ) l ON p.patkey = l.patownerref 
WHERE 
  row_num = 1;
